'''2025 U.S. National Championship''' was the Players Committee U.S. National Championship in Columbus, Ohio, 22–24 August 2025 (constructed 23–24 August). [[Matt Scott]] defeated [[Hayes Hunter]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-07-u-s-national-championship-columbus-ohio-aug-23-24-2025/</ref><ref name="wrap">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-us-nationals-wrap-up-matt-scott-takes-it-down/</ref>

Friday warmup was won by [[AJ Hatoum]]; Sunday Consolation by [[Joe Olson]].<ref name="wrap" />
